_doc.purpose: Configuration for the done-gate (and other) backpressure hooks. The done-gate's universal checks (verdict-file PASS, type-check, py-compile, no-API-key-literals-introduced) always run. The project-specific checks below NO-OP until you fill these fields, so the gate is safe to ship with empty defaults.
_doc.ipc_dirs: List of repo-relative path prefixes that hold cross-process channel handlers (e.g. ['main'] for a desktop shell, ['server/rpc'] for an RPC surface). When set, the gate verifies that every NEW channel registered this session is also wired into the bridge file and the typed client — a channel wired in one place out of three compiles fine and fails only at runtime. See ipc_preload_file / ipc_types_file. Empty = triple-wiring check disabled.
_doc.ipc_preload_file: Repo-relative path to the bridge file that must reference each new channel (e.g. 'main/preload.ts'). Empty = check disabled.
_doc.ipc_types_file: Repo-relative path to the typed client/surface that must reference each new channel (e.g. 'src/lib/rpc.ts'). Empty = check disabled.
_doc.migration_dir: Repo-relative directory holding SQL/DB migration files (e.g. 'src/lib/migrations'). When set, the gate checks: (a) new migration files are registered in migration_index_file; (b) ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN is guarded by a column-existence check; (c) the index calls the per-migration version recorder once per migration. Empty = all migration checks disabled.
_doc.migration_index_file: Repo-relative path to the migration registry/index that lists migrations and records applied versions (e.g. 'src/lib/migrations/index.ts'). Empty = registration + version-recorder checks disabled.
_doc.migration_version_fn: Name of the function the index must call once per migration to persist the schema version (e.g. 'insertSchemaVersion'). Empty = version-recorder check disabled.
_doc.migration_guard_pattern: Regex (egrep) matching an acceptable ALTER-safety guard in a migration file, e.g. 'columnExists\(|PRAGMA table_info'. Empty = ALTER-safety check disabled.
_doc.wrapper_allowed: Repo-relative path prefixes / filenames where introducing an API-key env reference is allowed (examples, docs, .env). Anything else triggers the 'no API key literals introduced' wrapper check.
_doc.wrapper_key_pattern: Regex (egrep) matching the API-key env-var names the wrapper check looks for in newly added lines. Defaults to a broad set of provider key names.
_doc.ts_targets: File extensions treated as TypeScript for the type-check (tsc --noEmit) and wrapper checks.
_doc.py_targets: File extensions treated as Python for py_compile and wrapper checks.
_doc.console_check_dirs: (lint-gate) Repo-relative dirs where console.* is forbidden (e.g. main/IPC/server code that must not pollute stdout). Empty = check disabled.
_doc.banned_ui_patterns: (lint-gate) List of regexes that must NOT appear in product source (e.g. platform-specific UI you forbid). Empty = check disabled.
_doc.product_paths: (non-target-script-detector) Repo-relative dirs treated as product code when scanning UI copy for stray writing systems. Keep it narrow: a detector that scans the whole repo trips on fixtures and gets switched off entirely. Defaults to ['src'].
_doc.renderer_dir: (post-write-check) The UI/renderer directory that must not reach across an architectural boundary (e.g. 'src'). Empty = cross-layer import check disabled.
_doc.renderer_forbidden_import: (post-write-check) Regex matching imports forbidden inside renderer_dir (e.g. "from 'electron'" or "from '\\.\\./server/"). Empty = check disabled.
